newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel looking for top at 130.56.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel looking for top at 130.56.

text.p: The June notionnel contract on the MATIF will try to put a top in place near-term around Tuesday's high at 130.56, technical analysts said on Wednesday.
A breakdown below support at Tuesday's low at 130.20 would help confirm the top and may trigger a move down towards 129.26, they added.
"Hourly technicals are still unwinding and daily technicals are still overbought, so we're looking for a top soonish," said Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London.
By 0820 GMT, the June notionnel was up 10 basis points at 130.48.
The notionnel's Relative Strength Index has been in overbought territory above 70 percent for the past two days. By 0820 GMT it was at 72 percent.
Branigan said the market was slightly bearish, particularly since it spiked up on Tuesday then fell again at the close.
Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell here said with intra-day stochastics crossing lower plus a potential cycle date in the next few days, a topping pattern may develop this week.
"The 130.06 steep trendline looks set to be tested as support, ahead of 129.66 short term," they said in a note to clients.
"Losses through these levels would spark more aggressive retracements towards 129.22 and 129.00 channel support," Deutsche said.
They said 129.00 was important support for the upward retracement phase with a break of that signalling a deep retreat over the next few weeks.
On the upside, if resistance at 130.88 were to be broken, the market would target the February 18 high at 131.58, said Deutsche.
By 0836 GMT, June Pibor was up five basis points at 96.56.
